name: NSL Foods Public Company Limited
summary: Headquartered in Nonthaburi, Thailand, NSL Foods Public Company Limited commenced operations in 2003. This enterprise primarily focuses on the production and distribution of a diverse range of food items. Its core activities involve manufacturing and supplying baked goods, including various snacks and sandwiches, throughout Thailand. Additionally, the company extends its offerings to include seafood products. NSL Foods also broadens its business through the wholesale trade of an assortment of frozen and processed foodstuffs, such as fish, other aquatic items, meats, seaweeds, and vegetables. These products are marketed under distinct brand names like CHILEE, Natural BITES, BUTTERFIN, and PANGTAI. The firm demonstrates extensive market reach, conducting both international exports and direct online sales. It was previously incorporated as NSL Foods Company Limited.
